theme: Verified delivery system for AGK Operative Systems — onboarding, test-driven implementation, review lane, deployment, doctor, and rollback

discovery.mission_statement: This OS exists to help AGK builders achieve traceable, verified OS delivery by systematically applying discovery, Librarian research, approach synthesis, and four owner-gated implementation cycles with doctor and rollback safeguards.
discovery.outcome: Verified, deployable AGK Operative System packages with documented evidence at every gate
discovery.method: Discovery → Librarian research → approach merge → owner validation gates → TDD build → independent review → doctor → rollback → release
existing_capabilities_reused: Hermes kanban review lane + sdlc-review skill
explicit_exclusions: No secrets in ledger, package, chat, or evidence
No RELEASE implied by START or research
No cross-tenant authority granted by OS designation
open_questions: Concrete provider/model values for primary and fallback routes (require owner confirmation)
Discord application ID, bot token, OAuth (owner-provisioned, not yet available)
assumptions: Package owns no live credentials or deployed infrastructure
START passed by explicit owner; RELEASE is distinct and unpassed

approaches.principle: Name recurring design structures with intent, context, participants, and trade-offs; prefer deep modules with simple interfaces
approaches.mechanism: NanoTeam roles use pattern vocabulary in design records; modules keep replaceable interfaces; evaluations test consequences not pattern-name presence
approaches.limitations: Patterns are contextual and era-dependent; naming a pattern does not prove it fits the architecture

approaches.principle: Small behavior-preserving transformations driven by characterization and regression evidence
approaches.mechanism: RED→GREEN→refactor cycles; characterization before legacy behavior change; rollback captures pre-state
approaches.limitations: Behavior-preserving depends on test coverage; refactoring can change timing or public quirks invisibly

approaches.principle: Express one observable behavior, witness failure for intended reason, add minimum implementation, then improve structure
approaches.mechanism: Nano Director enforces witnessed RED before GREEN; deterministic programs capture test command and exit; failure blocks done when test never failed
approaches.limitations: TDD does not discover the right product or prove complete correctness; poor tests can fossilize poor design

approaches.principle: Build once, record provenance and hash, promote identical artifact; never rebuild for promotion
approaches.mechanism: Package produces one checksum-pinned candidate; workflows promote rather than rebuild; SLSA provenance attestation required
approaches.limitations: Identical artifacts do not guarantee identical environments; pipeline automation can rapidly propagate defects

approaches.principle: Find seams, add characterization tests around observed behavior, introduce smallest safe point of control before changing poorly-covered code
approaches.mechanism: Blueprint distinguishes preserve-versus-correct; Stepper starts with characterization; MCP/tool contracts isolate dependencies
approaches.limitations: Characterization preserves observed behavior including defects; seam creation may increase complexity

approaches.principle: Reduce complexity through deep modules, explicit interfaces, minimal dependencies, and treat complexity as a design signal
approaches.mechanism: Design budgets dependencies and interface surface; profiles and tools use narrow typed contracts; Doctor exposes hidden state needed for diagnosis
approaches.limitations: Depth and simplicity are judgment calls; narrow interfaces can hide dangerous behavior

approaches.principle: Measure flow and stability as balanced socio-technical outcomes; treat capabilities as hypotheses linked to performance
approaches.mechanism: Evaluations track lead time, deploy frequency, recovery time, change-failure rate without ranking individuals; profiles set service baselines
approaches.limitations: Metrics can be gamed; population-level findings are context-dependent; correlation does not justify every causal claim

approaches.principle: Define reliability as an explicit SLO; use error budgets to balance change and stability; automate toil carefully
approaches.mechanism: Profiles declare SLOs and risk class; Doctor reports objective health; automations obey error-budget circuit breakers
approaches.limitations: SLOs can omit user harms; error budgets do not authorize unsafe releases

approaches.principle: Integrate secure-development preparation, software protection, vulnerability response into the development lifecycle with defined roles and evidence
approaches.mechanism: Package includes provenance and dependency inventory; workflows threat-model before coding; evaluations include abuse and vulnerability fixtures
approaches.limitations: SSDF is risk-based, not a certification; requires tailoring to technology and threat model

approaches.principle: Increase software supply-chain assurance through provenance, controlled build processes, and verifiable artifacts
approaches.mechanism: Package emits signed/checksummed provenance; Doctor verifies attestations; Recovery artifact pins dependencies
approaches.limitations: SLSA addresses supply-chain integrity, not source correctness or runtime safety

approaches.principle: Turn application security expectations into explicit testable requirements organized by verification area and assurance level
approaches.mechanism: Evaluations map applicable ASVS controls to evidence; Discord surface gets replay, authorization, and rendering probes
approaches.limitations: ASVS is web-application focused; checklist completion without threat modeling can miss system-specific abuse

approaches.principle: Treat delivery and AI-assisted development outcomes as socio-technical and empirical; measure local effects and expose trade-offs
approaches.mechanism: Evaluations version metrics and preserve errata; automations avoid target gaming; Nano Director compares speed with quality
approaches.limitations: Survey findings are time-bound and self-reported; aggregate benchmarks should not become detached targets

approaches.principle: Declare a public API and communicate compatible additions, fixes, and breaking changes through deterministic MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH
approaches.mechanism: Package validates versions and dependency ranges; workflows produce migration previews; Doctor detects skew
approaches.limitations: Version numbers do not detect hidden behavior, data migrations, or undeclared consumers

approaches.principle: Software quality is multidimensional; requirements must address functional suitability alongside reliability, security, maintainability, and safety
approaches.mechanism: Blueprint declares quality priorities and trade-offs; evaluations map acceptance tests to named attributes; profiles set thresholds by context
approaches.limitations: Quality attributes require context-specific measures; maximizing every attribute is impossible

approaches.principle: Design rollback and recovery before irreversible change; keep software releasable through versioned configuration and automated pipelines
approaches.mechanism: Every mutation declares pre-state, inverse, and verification; rollback captures pre-state; Doctor reports rollback readiness; recovery artifact enables isolated restore
approaches.limitations: Rollback can fail if inverse is not safe or data effects are not fully understood

merge_matrix.resolution: APR-02 and APR-03 are complementary; TDD provides the cycle discipline that refactoring operationalizes
APR-07 provides the measurement framework; APR-08 operationalizes reliability targets within it
ASVS is web-focused; adapt to AGK OS context (Discord surface, tool contracts, profiles)
APR-04 and APR-15 reinforce each other: build-once artifact discipline enables reliable rollback and recovery
